def zip_longest_sum(left, right):
    result = []
    i = j = 0
    while i < len(left) or j < len(right):
        a = left[i] if i < len(left) else 0
        b = right[j] if j < len(right) else 0
        result.append(a + b)
        i += 1
        j += 1
    return result
